errorCodes.meaning: No account with this id exists in the named context that the caller may see. See the family conventions §2.
The account is `archived`; restore it before changing or using it. See the family conventions §2.
The provider could not be reached or did not answer in time.

AccountContextId.description: The custodian context that owns the account. Act scope in this context decides who may manage the account and who may consume it; the account's keys are derived in this context's key space.
AccountContextId.title: AccountContextId

AccountId.description: The account's identifier within its context, chosen by whoever creates it. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, so that it can be embedded in a certificate subject, a token subject or a provider-side condition without escaping. Unique per context; never reused after deletion while anything that names it (a provider-side trust policy, an audit row) may still exist.
AccountId.title: AccountId

complete.description: True only when the canary steps (`put`, `get`, `delete`, or the model's equivalent) ran, so the account was exercised end to end. A probe that stopped after `exchange` because nothing named a canary prefix is `complete: false` even when `ok` is true, and does not clear `providerSetupRequired`.

ok.description: True when every step that ran succeeded.

steps.description: In order; the first failing step ends the probe.

providerError.description: The provider's error, verbatim and truncated, so an administrator sees the cloud's own words. Untrusted text. A custodian MUST remove any credential, signature or token from it first.

AccountProbeStep.description: `sign`: the custodian signed its assertion, session request or test transaction. `exchange`: the provider issued a credential for it. `put`, `get`, `delete`: one canary object at the narrowest scope of the account's bindings. `decode`: for `sui-signer`, a built test transaction passed the allow-list (it is never submitted).
AccountProbeStep.title: AccountProbeStep

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext
